## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND showing lower fear and SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND with SPY/TLT rising, offset by rising credit stress (HYG/LQD level 0.7544) and very narrow sector breadth.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds RISK-ON signal: SPY/TLT (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +4.62%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD (level 0.7544 | 1W: +0.76% | 1M: +0.74%) → flat ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-TAUT: Dollar strength UUP proxy up (Dollar Strength 1W: +0.49% | 1M: +1.56%) ABOVE TREND while bond yields are rising (TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND) and the yield curve flattening (Yield Curve 1W: -2.94%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leadership narrow: XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, Healthcare mixed with XLV (1W: +1.76% | 1M: -1.26%) RECOVERY, Materials marginal (XLB (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -6.78%) RECOVERY). Style: Growth showing strength but leadership is narrow given 3/11 breadth.

5. US vs Global?
US modestly outperforming: SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND while Emerging Markets EEM (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND showing patchy EM resilience and China FXI (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND lagging.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation alive: IBIT (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +5.82%) ABOVE TREND; small caps weak IWM (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -5.43%) BELOW TREND — speculative flows biased to big-tech/crypto ETFs.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Mixed: Copper CPER (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND signaling industrial demand, oil ETFs showing 1M strength but 1W weakness BNO (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%) CORRECTION, and Gold GLD (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND under pressure.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy soft: XLE (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%) BELOW TREND while natural gas UNG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND — divergent within the complex.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis leadership with XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Major mismatch between narrow equity breadth (3/11) and 1M commodity strength (BNO/USO CORRECTION patterns) plus rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) — note but treat as a cross-asset rotation signal.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to tech/semis ETFs (XLK, SOXX) showing durable leadership, reduce exposure to rate-sensitive and defensive areas as bonds (TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND) rerate, and monitor credit via HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) and SOXX (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) if semis leadership persists. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%) and XLU (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%) if defensive flows continue to lag.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: UNG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) if weather/demand supports natural gas. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%) if dollar and yields remain elevated.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~17–20 as complacency gauge (VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND). HYG/LQD ~0.75 credit-health pivot (HYG/LQD level 0.7544 | 1W: +0.76% | 1M: +0.74%). XLK/XLF tech vs financials pivot ~3.58 (Tech vs Financials level 3.5790 | 1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.72%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; tech leadership is narrow with XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: rising credit stress (HYG/LQD level 0.7544) and narrow breadth amid divergent commodity signals warrant monitoring.
